verdict.rationale: Several sources confirm a desktop app. The CLI integrates with the 1Password app and unlocks via Touch ID or Windows Hello, SSH commit signing is configured from the 1Password app, and a user reports that all apps, desktop and mobile, work great. One-time password storage and access is documented as a core feature. Community remarks that the desktop app is Electron rather than native, and an older complaint about no Linux client, question how first-class it is but do not contradict that it exists. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party desktop app doc, explicit evidence that one-time codes are shown in the desktop app, and current platform coverage including Linux.
